messages:
amanda: Auditor reached out asking for SOC2 evidence bundle for the KMS + API access during the billing spike incident. They want exports, repro steps, and a chain-of-custody manifest. Deadline EOD Fri (3 days).

raj: On it. Which retention window and sample size do they require? Also — do they want signed hashes or just S3 objects?

amanda: Auditor requested proof of 90-day retention and a 10-sample access log plus KMS rotation logs tied to production CMKs. They explicitly asked for a signed manifest and repro steps for the 2024-10-11 03:12 UTC billing spike.

auditor_bot: Reminder: evidence-request ID #A-3412 created. Due 2024-10-20. Attach uploads to the ticket and notify the auditor contact.

julia: I can export access logs + KMS key rotation events. Will follow the export playbook: https://redwood.internal/docs/compliance/export-playbook (internal). Proposed S3 path: s3://redwood-evidence/soc2/A-3412/exports/1992468000/

julia: Export commands (run from compliance-runner role):
```
aws s3 cp s3://prod-logs/api/access/2024/10/11/ s3://redwood-evidence/soc2/A-3412/exports/1992468000/access/ --recursive --profile compliance-runner
gcloud logging read "resource.type=global AND timestamp>=\"2024-10-11T03:00:00Z\"" --format=json > access-20241011.json
```

kevin: Timeline from support: at 2024-10-11T03:11:40Z we started seeing 503 spikes tied to an onboarding job that retried due to an expired service-account token. That created an exponential retry loop and caused a lot of KMS Encrypt/Decrypt calls — explains the bill spike.

kevin: Repro steps I used locally to simulate the spike (sanitized):
```
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=redacted
for i in {1..200}; do
  curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d '{"prompt":"repro test","max_tokens":8}' \
    https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate || true
done
```

raj: We'll include that repro script, a sanitized packet capture, and the incident timeline. Julia, can you create a signed manifest with SHA256 hashes and timestamps? Auditor wants chain-of-custody verification.

julia: Yes. I'll compute sha256s and sign the manifest with the compliance PGP key. Example manifest header I'll produce: 
```
manifest_version: 1
evidence_id: A-3412
generated_by: julia
generated_at: 2024-10-15T14:05:00Z
signature: <PGP_SIG>
```
I'll attach file-level hashes and upload to s3://redwood-evidence/soc2/A-3412/manifest/ and set object ACLs per playbook.

amanda: Please also include scope notes: which service accounts, which CMK ARNs, and the rotation timeline. Auditor will ask for the key IDs and rotation entries.

julia: Pulling rotation history now. Current CMKs to include: arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd-1111 and arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/efgh-2222. Will include last-rotate timestamps and the principal who rotated.

raj: After exports and manifest are ready I'll create the evidence ticket with direct links and mark it as "submitted to auditor". I'll also schedule a short live Q&A slot if they request it.

kevin: FYI support will attach the incident runbook and the internal support thread (ref slack://thread?ts=1991023345). We'll sanitize any PII before upload.

amanda: :thumbsup: Good. Ping me once everything is uploaded. I'll be the point for the auditor's live questions.

julia: Uploads scheduled in 30m. I'll post final S3 links and the signed manifest here when complete. :eyes:
